s01: Good morning, my friend! (pause) Yesterday we got ready for school. (pause) Today we sing songs. (pause) And we listen to stories!
kubo: Look at this little house. (pause) It is a bahay kubo. (pause) It is a small house. (pause) Look all around it. (pause) It has a big garden with many vegetables!
veg: Let us meet some vegetables! (pause) Tap each one. (pause) Say its name with me.
veg-1: Pechay. (pause) It has big green leaves!
veg-2: Bawang. (pause) In English, garlic. (pause) It is white!
veg-3: Luya. (pause) In English, ginger. (pause) It is brown and bumpy!
song: Now let us sing! (pause) Tap a line to hear it. (pause) Or tap the big button to sing it all. (pause) Listen for bawang and luya!
song-3: Singkamas at talong, sigarilyas at mani,
find-veg: Can you find the vegetables? (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap!
find-veg-q1: Where is the garlic? The bawang?
find-veg-q2: Where is the ginger? The luya?
find-veg-q3: Where is the pechay? The one with green leaves?
move: Please stand up! (pause) Let us sing and move. (pause) Touch each part of your body with me!
t1: Story time! (pause) This is Turtle. (pause) And this is Monkey. (pause) They find a banana plant. (pause) They cut it in two. (pause) Monkey takes the top. Turtle takes the bottom.
t2: Monkey laughs at Turtle. (pause) But Turtle plants it. (pause) She waters it every day. (pause) It grows tall. (pause) It grows bananas! (pause) Turtle is kind and patient.
t-check: Let us think about the story.
t-check-q1-yes: Yes! Turtle was kind and patient. (pause) And she got bananas!
p1: Here is another story. (pause) This is Pina. (pause) Her mother was sick. (pause) She asked Pina to help. (pause) But Pina said, I cannot find it! (pause) She did not even look.
p2: The next day, Pina was gone. (pause) A new fruit grew in the garden. (pause) It had many, many eyes! (pause) It is the pineapple. (pause) The pinya!
p-check: What does the story teach us?
p-check-q1: What should we do at home?
p-check-q1-yes: Yes! We help at home. (pause) Every little help is a big help!
like: Which story did you like? (pause) Tap one. (pause) Then say it with me.
like-1: I like the story about the turtle.
like-2: I like the story about the pineapple.
verse: Our Bible verse is, (pause) Honor your father and your mother. (pause) We honor them when we help at home.
verse-verse: Honor your father and your mother. (pause) Exodus twenty, verse twelve.
done: Hooray! (pause) You sang Bahay Kubo. (pause) You moved your body. (pause) And you listened to two stories. (pause) See you tomorrow!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
